# Purpose

Single Rmd that compiles thesis-ready figures from the existing tidymodels FS
results and the cleaned screen data. Each section saves a high-DPI PNG into
`Thesis_figures/figs/` so figures can be dropped directly into the manuscript.

Conventions:
- 3 seeds: 1969, 1986, 2024
- "Top dAbs" = the union of the top performers across LASSO and RF
  (see project memory): dAb5, dAb6, dAb8, dAb13, dAb16, dAb17, dAb18, dAb19
- All `*_fvr` tibbles below come from the `final_test_results` slot -- retrained
  on full TRAINING and scored on FINAL_TEST at each feature count.

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(RColorBrewer)

# tidymodels FS scripts pull in optional engines (discrim, plsmod, earth).
# We only need plot_perf_by_features from them; if a package is missing, skip
# the source -- the .rds results still load fine and we redefine our own
# aggregation below.
safe_source <- function(path) {
  tryCatch(source(path),
           error = function(e) message("Skipped ", path, ": ", conditionMessage(e)))
}
safe_source("Embedded_FS/lasso_tidymodels.R")
safe_source("Embedded_FS/rf_tidymodels.R")
safe_source("Embedded_FS/mars_tidymodels.R")
safe_source("Embedded_FS/pls_tidymodels.R")
source("Visualization_and_preprocessing/S_protein_screen_preprocessing.R")

FIG_DIR <- "Thesis_figures/figs"
dir.create(FIG_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

VARIANT_LEVELS <- c("WT", "Beta", "Delta", "Omicron")
VARIANT_COLORS <- c(WT      = "#4C72B0",
                    Beta    = "#DD8452",
                    Delta   = "#55A868",
                    Omicron = "#C44E52")

TOP_DABS <- c("dAb5", "dAb6", "dAb8", "dAb13",
              "dAb16", "dAb17", "dAb18", "dAb19")

save_fig <- function(plot, name, width = 8, height = 5) {
  path <- file.path(FIG_DIR, paste0(name, ".png"))
  ggsave(path, plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
  message("Saved: ", path)
  invisible(path)
}
```

```{r load-fs-runs}
# All FS runs are list-of-lists: outer = seed run, inner = named by dAb,
# leaves contain $final_test_results, $feature_val_results, $test_metrics,
# $test_conf_mat, $feature_ranking, $run_summary, $best_features
rf_runs     <- readRDS("Embedded_FS/all_rf_runs_multiseed.rds")
lasso_runs  <- readRDS("Embedded_FS/all_lasso_runs_multiseed.rds")
mars_runs   <- readRDS("Embedded_FS/all_mars_runs_multiseed.rds")
pls_runs    <- readRDS("Embedded_FS/all_pls_runs_multiseed.rds")
mrmr_runs   <- readRDS("Embedded_FS/all_mrmr_runs_multiseed.rds")
boruta_runs <- readRDS("Embedded_FS/all_boruta_runs_multiseed.rds")

extract_slot <- function(runs, slot) {
  map_dfr(runs, \(run) map_dfr(run, \(x) x[[slot]]))
}

method_runs <- list(
  LASSO  = lasso_runs,
  RF     = rf_runs,
  MARS   = mars_runs,
  `PLS-DA` = pls_runs,
  mRMR   = mrmr_runs,
  Boruta = boruta_runs
)

# Stacked, long: all (method x seed x dAb x n_features x .metric) rows
all_fvr <- imap_dfr(method_runs, \(runs, m)
  extract_slot(runs, "final_test_results") |> mutate(method = m)
)

all_test_metrics <- imap_dfr(method_runs, \(runs, m)
  extract_slot(runs, "test_metrics") |> mutate(method = m)
)

all_run_summary <- imap_dfr(method_runs, \(runs, m)
  extract_slot(runs, "run_summary") |> mutate(method = m)
)

# dAb factor with consistent natural ordering (numeric inside the label)
dab_levels <- all_fvr$dab |> unique() |>
  (\(x) x[order(as.integer(str_remove(x, "dAb")))])()
all_fvr$dab <- factor(all_fvr$dab, levels = dab_levels)
all_test_metrics$dab <- factor(all_test_metrics$dab, levels = dab_levels)
```

```{r load-screen-data}
# Returns a named list of 13 dAb dataframes. Each has Conc., Replicates,
# target_vector, and dAbX_cAbY columns. Long form below for plotting.
dab_list <- main_preprocessor()  # reads data/covid_screen_data_cleaned.csv internally

screen_long <- imap_dfr(dab_list, function(df, dab) {
  df |>
    pivot_longer(starts_with(paste0(dab, "_")),
                 names_to = "pair", values_to = "fluor") |>
    mutate(dab = dab,
           cab = str_remove(pair, paste0(dab, "_")),
           target_vector = factor(target_vector, levels = VARIANT_LEVELS))
})
```

# 1. Cross-method performance grid (aggregate)

One panel per method, same axes. Mean accuracy / kappa / macro-F1 vs. feature
count, +/-1 SE across (seed x dAb).

```{r fig-1-cross-method-grid, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
agg_summary <- all_fvr |>
  filter(.metric %in% c("accuracy", "kap", "f_meas")) |>
  mutate(metric_label = recode(.metric,
                               accuracy = "Accuracy",
                               kap      = "Kappa",
                               f_meas   = "Macro-F1")) |>
  group_by(method, n_features, metric_label) |>
  summarise(mean_val = mean(.estimate),
            se_val   = sd(.estimate) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups  = "drop")

p1 <- ggplot(agg_summary,
             aes(n_features, mean_val,
                 color = metric_label, group = metric_label)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_val - se_val, ymax = mean_val + se_val),
                width = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ method, ncol = 3) +
  scale_x_reverse(breaks = sort(unique(agg_summary$n_features), decreasing = TRUE)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Accuracy   = "#6BAED6",
                                `Macro-F1` = "#2171B5",
                                Kappa      = "#08306B"),
                     name = "Metric") +
  labs(x = "Number of antibody pairs in the model",
       y = "Mean performance (across 3 seeds x all dAbs)",
       title = "Performance vs. feature subset size by FS method") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

save_fig(p1, "01_cross_method_perf_grid", width = 12, height = 7)
p1
```

# 2. Method x dAb accuracy heatmap

Mean test accuracy at each method's auto-selected `best_n_features`, averaged
across seeds. Reveals which dAbs are universally easy and which are
method-dependent.

```{r fig-2-method-dab-heatmap, fig.width=11, fig.height=4.5}
acc_by_method_dab <- all_test_metrics |>
  filter(.metric == "accuracy") |>
  group_by(method, dab) |>
  summarise(mean_acc = mean(.estimate),
            sd_acc   = sd(.estimate),
            .groups  = "drop")

p2 <- ggplot(acc_by_method_dab,
             aes(dab, fct_rev(factor(method)), fill = mean_acc)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", mean_acc)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#B2182B", mid = "#F7F7F7", high = "#2166AC",
                       midpoint = 0.5, limits = c(0, 1),
                       name = "Mean test\naccuracy") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       title = "Test accuracy by FS method x dAb (mean across 3 seeds)",
       subtitle = "At each method's auto-selected best N features") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid  = element_blank())

save_fig(p2, "02_method_dab_acc_heatmap", width = 11, height = 4.5)
p2
```

# 6. Dose-response curves for selected pairs

Mean fluorescence vs. concentration, faceted by variant. Picks the top-ranked
cAb partner for each top dAb (ranked by LASSO importance averaged across seeds).

```{r fig-6-dose-response, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# Top-1 cAb partner per top dAb from LASSO importance (averaged across seeds)
top_pairs <- extract_slot(lasso_runs, "feature_ranking") |>
  filter(str_detect(feature, paste0("^", paste(TOP_DABS, collapse = "|"), "_"))) |>
  mutate(dab = str_extract(feature, "^dAb[0-9]+")) |>
  group_by(dab, feature) |>
  summarise(mean_imp = mean(importance), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(dab) |>
  slice_max(mean_imp, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(cab = str_remove(feature, "^dAb[0-9]+_"))

dr_data <- screen_long |>
  semi_join(top_pairs, by = c("dab", "cab")) |>
  group_by(dab, cab, target_vector, Conc.) |>
  summarise(mean_f = mean(fluor),
            sd_f   = sd(fluor),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(pair_label = paste0(dab, " x ", cab),
         pair_label = factor(pair_label,
                             levels = paste0(TOP_DABS, " x ",
                                             top_pairs$cab[match(TOP_DABS, top_pairs$dab)])))

p6 <- ggplot(dr_data,
             aes(Conc., mean_f, color = target_vector, group = target_vector)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_f - sd_f, ymax = mean_f + sd_f,
                  fill = target_vector),
              alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_number()) +
  scale_color_manual(values = VARIANT_COLORS, name = "Variant") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = VARIANT_COLORS, guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ pair_label, ncol = 4, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Concentration (ng/mL, log scale)",
       y = "Fluorescence (mean +/- SD across replicates)",
       title = "Dose-response by variant for top-LASSO cAb partner per dAb") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position  = "bottom")

save_fig(p6, "06_dose_response_top_pairs", width = 12, height = 8)
p6
```

# 3. Feature-frequency heatmap (selected pairs across methods)

For each top dAb, count how many (method x seed) runs picked each cAb pair into
the final model. Reveals which pairs are "consensus" picks vs. method-specific.
Each cell maxes at 18 = 6 methods x 3 seeds.

```{r fig-3-feature-frequency, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
selected_features <- imap_dfr(method_runs, \(runs, m)
  imap_dfr(runs, \(run, seed_idx)
    map_dfr(run, \(x) {
      bf <- x$run_summary$best_features[[1]]
      if (is.null(bf) || length(bf) == 0) return(tibble())
      tibble(method = m,
             seed   = x$run_summary$seed,
             dab    = x$run_summary$dab,
             feature = bf)
    })
  )
) |>
  mutate(cab = str_remove(feature, "^dAb[0-9]+_"))

freq_df <- selected_features |>
  filter(dab %in% TOP_DABS) |>
  group_by(dab, cab) |>
  summarise(n_selections = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(dab = factor(dab, levels = TOP_DABS),
         cab = factor(cab, levels = paste0("cAb", 1:29)))

p3 <- ggplot(freq_df, aes(cab, fct_rev(dab), fill = n_selections)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_selections,
                color = n_selections > 9), size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "white", `FALSE` = "grey15")) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F7FBFF", high = "#08306B",
                      name = "# (method x seed)\nselections",
                      limits = c(0, 18)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       title = "Selection frequency of cAb pairs by dAb",
       subtitle = "Counts across 6 FS methods x 3 seeds (max 18). High counts = consensus pairs.") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid  = element_blank())

save_fig(p3, "03_feature_frequency_heatmap", width = 12, height = 5)
p3
```

# 4. Confusion matrices for top dAbs (RF, summed across seeds)

Each `$test_conf_mat` is a `yardstick::conf_mat`. Sum the underlying tables
across the 3 seeds per dAb so each cell reflects the full evaluation.

```{r fig-4-confusion-matrices, fig.width=14, fig.height=7}
get_cm_table <- function(cm) {
  tab <- cm$table
  as_tibble(as.table(tab))
}

cm_long <- imap_dfr(method_runs, \(runs, m)
  map_dfr(runs, \(run)
    imap_dfr(run, \(x, dab_name)
      get_cm_table(x$test_conf_mat) |> mutate(dab = dab_name)
    )
  ) |> mutate(method = m)
) |>
  rename(predicted = Prediction, truth = Truth, count = n) |>
  mutate(truth     = factor(truth,     levels = VARIANT_LEVELS),
         predicted = factor(predicted, levels = VARIANT_LEVELS))

cm_rf_top <- cm_long |>
  filter(method == "RF", dab %in% TOP_DABS) |>
  group_by(dab, truth, predicted) |>
  summarise(count = sum(count), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(dab, truth) |>
  mutate(prop = count / sum(count)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(dab = factor(dab, levels = TOP_DABS))

p4 <- ggplot(cm_rf_top, aes(predicted, fct_rev(truth), fill = prop)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%d\n(%.0f%%)", count, 100 * prop)),
            size = 2.6, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F7FBFF", high = "#2171B5",
                      limits = c(0, 1), name = "Row prop.") +
  facet_wrap(~ dab, ncol = 4) +
  labs(x = "Predicted variant", y = "True variant",
       title = "RF test-set confusion matrices for top dAbs",
       subtitle = "Counts (and row %) summed across 3 seeds at each dAb's best N features") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

save_fig(p4, "04_confusion_matrices_rf_top", width = 14, height = 7)
p4
```

# 5. Per-class precision / recall / F1 (RF, top dAbs)

Derived directly from the summed confusion matrices in section 4.

```{r fig-5-per-class-metrics, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
per_class_df <- cm_rf_top |>
  group_by(dab) |>
  group_modify(~ {
    tab <- xtabs(count ~ truth + predicted, data = .x)
    map_dfr(VARIANT_LEVELS, \(v) {
      tp <- tab[v, v]
      fn <- sum(tab[v, ]) - tp
      fp <- sum(tab[, v]) - tp
      precision <- ifelse(tp + fp == 0, NA, tp / (tp + fp))
      recall    <- ifelse(tp + fn == 0, NA, tp / (tp + fn))
      f1        <- ifelse(is.na(precision) || is.na(recall) || (precision + recall) == 0,
                          NA, 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall))
      tibble(variant = v, precision = precision, recall = recall, f1 = f1)
    })
  }) |>
  ungroup() |>
  pivot_longer(c(precision, recall, f1),
               names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(metric  = factor(metric, levels = c("precision", "recall", "f1"),
                                  labels = c("Precision", "Recall", "F1")),
         variant = factor(variant, levels = VARIANT_LEVELS))

p5 <- ggplot(per_class_df,
             aes(variant, value, fill = variant)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", value)),
            vjust = -0.3, size = 2.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = VARIANT_COLORS, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.08), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
  facet_grid(metric ~ dab) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Score",
       title = "Per-variant precision / recall / F1 (RF, summed across 3 seeds)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

save_fig(p5, "05_per_class_metrics_rf", width = 12, height = 6)
p5
```

# 7. Replicate coefficient-of-variation (CV) ranking

CV = sd / mean across the 3 replicates at each (Conc. x variant). Lower CV =
more reproducible pair. Top 25 most reproducible and bottom 25 least.

```{r fig-7-replicate-cv, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
cv_df <- screen_long |>
  group_by(dab, cab, Conc., target_vector) |>
  summarise(cv = sd(fluor) / mean(fluor), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(dab, cab) |>
  summarise(mean_cv = mean(cv, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_obs = n(),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(pair = paste0(dab, "_", cab))

cv_top <- cv_df |> slice_min(mean_cv, n = 25) |> mutate(group = "Most reproducible (low CV)")
cv_bot <- cv_df |> slice_max(mean_cv, n = 25) |> mutate(group = "Least reproducible (high CV)")
cv_extreme <- bind_rows(cv_top, cv_bot) |>
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Most reproducible (low CV)",
                                          "Least reproducible (high CV)")),
         pair  = fct_reorder(pair, mean_cv))

p7 <- ggplot(cv_extreme, aes(mean_cv, pair, fill = dab)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~ group, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired", name = "dAb") +
  labs(x = "Mean CV across (Conc. x variant) cells", y = NULL,
       title = "Replicate reproducibility ranking of antibody pairs",
       subtitle = "Top 25 most/least reproducible pairs across all dAbs") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

save_fig(p7, "07_replicate_cv_ranking", width = 12, height = 7)
p7
```

# 8. PCA per top dAb, colored by variant

For each top dAb, run prcomp on its 29 cAb columns; show first 2 PCs.

```{r fig-8-pca-per-dab, fig.width=14, fig.height=7}
pca_df <- map_dfr(TOP_DABS, function(d) {
  df <- dab_list[[d]]
  feat <- df |> select(starts_with(paste0(d, "_")))
  pca <- prcomp(feat, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
  tibble(dab = d,
         PC1 = pca$x[, 1],
         PC2 = pca$x[, 2],
         var1 = round(100 * (pca$sdev[1]^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)), 1),
         var2 = round(100 * (pca$sdev[2]^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)), 1),
         target_vector = factor(df$target_vector, levels = VARIANT_LEVELS))
}) |>
  group_by(dab) |>
  mutate(panel_label = paste0(dab, "  (PC1 ", var1[1], "%, PC2 ", var2[1], "%)")) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(panel_label = factor(panel_label,
                              levels = unique(panel_label)[order(match(
                                str_extract(unique(panel_label), "^dAb[0-9]+"),
                                TOP_DABS))]))

p8 <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = target_vector)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75, size = 1.4) +
  stat_ellipse(level = 0.68, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = VARIANT_COLORS, name = "Variant") +
  facet_wrap(~ panel_label, ncol = 4, scales = "free") +
  labs(title = "PCA of all 29 cAb columns per top dAb (colored by variant)",
       subtitle = "Ellipses = 68% confidence; visualizes pre-classification separability") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position  = "bottom",
        strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = NA),
        aspect.ratio     = 0.9)

save_fig(p8, "08_pca_per_dab", width = 14, height = 7)
p8
```

# 9. Augmented vs. original distribution overlay

`covspot_data_aug_1_processed.csv` has a different shape (single-dAb, columns
named cAbX). Overlay the per-cAb fluorescence density of the augmented set
against the matching original subset for the dAb the augmented file covers.

```{r fig-9-augmented-overlay, fig.width=14, fig.height=7}
aug_path <- "Embedded_FS/covspot_data_aug_1_processed.csv"
if (file.exists(aug_path)) {
  aug_df <- read.csv(aug_path) |>
    mutate(target_vector = factor(target_vector, levels = VARIANT_LEVELS))

  cab_cols <- aug_df |> select(starts_with("cAb")) |> colnames()

  # Try to match the dAb whose original cAb columns overlap with aug_df's
  candidate_dabs <- map_dfr(names(dab_list), function(d) {
    orig_cabs <- str_remove(grep(paste0("^", d, "_"),
                                 colnames(dab_list[[d]]), value = TRUE),
                            paste0("^", d, "_"))
    tibble(dab = d, n_overlap = length(intersect(cab_cols, orig_cabs)))
  }) |> arrange(desc(n_overlap))

  matched_dab <- candidate_dabs$dab[1]
  message("Augmented file matched to: ", matched_dab,
          " (", candidate_dabs$n_overlap[1], " overlapping cAbs)")

  orig_long <- screen_long |>
    filter(dab == matched_dab, cab %in% cab_cols) |>
    mutate(source = "Original")

  aug_long <- aug_df |>
    pivot_longer(all_of(cab_cols), names_to = "cab", values_to = "fluor") |>
    mutate(dab = matched_dab, source = "Augmented")

  overlay_df <- bind_rows(
    orig_long |> select(dab, cab, target_vector, fluor, source),
    aug_long  |> select(dab, cab, target_vector, fluor, source)
  ) |>
    filter(!is.na(target_vector), target_vector %in% VARIANT_LEVELS) |>
    mutate(target_vector = factor(target_vector, levels = VARIANT_LEVELS),
           source        = factor(source, levels = c("Original", "Augmented")))

  p9 <- ggplot(overlay_df, aes(fluor, fill = source, color = source)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = c(Original = "#4C72B0", Augmented = "#DD8452")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(Original = "#4C72B0", Augmented = "#DD8452")) +
    facet_grid(target_vector ~ cab, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = "Fluorescence", y = "Density",
         title = paste0("Augmented vs. original distributions (", matched_dab, ")"),
         subtitle = "One panel per (cAb x variant); checks whether augmentation preserved the manifold") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          strip.text.x     = element_text(size = 7),
          legend.position  = "bottom")

  save_fig(p9, "09_augmented_vs_original", width = 14, height = 7)
  p9
} else {
  message("Augmented file not found at ", aug_path, " -- skipping section 9.")
}
```

---

# 10. ROC / PR curves (one-vs-rest) for chosen RF models

Re-augments each RF top-dAb final fit on its stored final_test split, stacks
predicted probabilities across seeds, and draws one-vs-rest ROC and PR curves
per variant.

```{r fig-10-roc-pr, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
roc_pr_data <- map_dfr(TOP_DABS, function(d) {
  imap_dfr(rf_runs, function(run, seed_idx) {
    res <- run[[d]]
    if (is.null(res) || is.null(res$final_fit) || is.null(res$final_split)) return(tibble())
    test <- testing(res$final_split)
    aug  <- augment(res$final_fit, new_data = test)
    prob_cols <- grep("^\\.pred_", colnames(aug), value = TRUE)
    prob_cols <- setdiff(prob_cols, ".pred_class")
    aug |> select(target_vector, all_of(prob_cols)) |>
      mutate(dab = d, seed_idx = seed_idx)
  })
}) |>
  mutate(target_vector = factor(target_vector, levels = VARIANT_LEVELS))

if (nrow(roc_pr_data) > 0) {
  prob_cols <- grep("^\\.pred_", colnames(roc_pr_data), value = TRUE)
  prob_cols <- setdiff(prob_cols, ".pred_class")

  roc_df <- map_dfr(VARIANT_LEVELS, function(v) {
    pcol <- paste0(".pred_", v)
    if (!pcol %in% prob_cols) return(tibble())
    map_dfr(TOP_DABS, function(d) {
      sub <- roc_pr_data |> filter(dab == d)
      if (nrow(sub) == 0) return(tibble())
      sub <- sub |> mutate(positive = factor(target_vector == v,
                                             levels = c(TRUE, FALSE),
                                             labels = c("yes", "no")))
      yardstick::roc_curve(sub, truth = positive, !!sym(pcol)) |>
        mutate(dab = d, variant = v)
    })
  }) |>
    mutate(dab     = factor(dab, levels = TOP_DABS),
           variant = factor(variant, levels = VARIANT_LEVELS))

  p10 <- ggplot(roc_df, aes(1 - specificity, sensitivity,
                            color = variant)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "grey80", linetype = 2) +
    geom_path(linewidth = 0.7) +
    scale_color_manual(values = VARIANT_COLORS, name = "Variant (vs. rest)") +
    coord_equal() +
    facet_wrap(~ dab, ncol = 4) +
    labs(x = "1 - Specificity", y = "Sensitivity",
         title = "RF one-vs-rest ROC curves per top dAb",
         subtitle = "Predictions stacked across 3 seeds; final-test splits") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          legend.position  = "bottom")

  save_fig(p10, "10_roc_curves_rf_top", width = 14, height = 7)
  p10
} else {
  message("No RF predictions could be regenerated (final_split/final_fit missing).")
}
```

# 11. Calibration plot (RF, top dAbs combined)

For each variant, bin the predicted probability and compare to the observed
fraction. Built from the same `roc_pr_data` as section 10.

```{r fig-11-calibration, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
if (exists("roc_pr_data") && nrow(roc_pr_data) > 0) {
  prob_cols <- grep("^\\.pred_", colnames(roc_pr_data), value = TRUE)
  prob_cols <- setdiff(prob_cols, ".pred_class")

  calib_df <- map_dfr(VARIANT_LEVELS, function(v) {
    pcol <- paste0(".pred_", v)
    if (!pcol %in% prob_cols) return(tibble())
    roc_pr_data |>
      transmute(prob = .data[[pcol]],
                outcome = as.integer(target_vector == v),
                variant = v) |>
      mutate(bin = cut(prob,
                       breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1),
                       include.lowest = TRUE)) |>
      group_by(variant, bin) |>
      summarise(mean_pred = mean(prob),
                obs_rate  = mean(outcome),
                n         = n(),
                .groups   = "drop") |>
      filter(n >= 5)
  }) |> mutate(variant = factor(variant, levels = VARIANT_LEVELS))

  p11 <- ggplot(calib_df, aes(mean_pred, obs_rate,
                              color = variant, size = n)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "grey70", linetype = 2) +
    geom_line(aes(group = variant), linewidth = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_color_manual(values = VARIANT_COLORS, name = "Variant") +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Bin count", range = c(2, 6)) +
    coord_equal(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(x = "Mean predicted probability", y = "Observed positive rate",
         title = "RF calibration per variant (top dAbs combined, 3 seeds)",
         subtitle = "Diagonal = perfect calibration") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

  save_fig(p11, "11_calibration_rf", width = 10, height = 5)
  p11
}
```

# 12. Pair importance x dAb panel (LASSO)

For each top dAb, the top 8 cAb pairs by mean LASSO importance across seeds,
with selection-frequency overlay.

```{r fig-12-pair-importance, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
imp_df <- extract_slot(lasso_runs, "feature_ranking") |>
  mutate(dab = str_extract(feature, "^dAb[0-9]+"),
         cab = str_remove(feature, "^dAb[0-9]+_")) |>
  filter(dab %in% TOP_DABS) |>
  group_by(dab, cab) |>
  summarise(mean_imp = mean(importance),
            sd_imp   = sd(importance),
            .groups  = "drop")

# Selection frequency: how many (seed) runs picked it into best_features
sel_freq_lasso <- selected_features |>
  filter(method == "LASSO", dab %in% TOP_DABS) |>
  group_by(dab, cab) |>
  summarise(n_sel = n(), .groups = "drop")

imp_top <- imp_df |>
  group_by(dab) |>
  slice_max(mean_imp, n = 8, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  left_join(sel_freq_lasso, by = c("dab", "cab")) |>
  mutate(n_sel = replace_na(n_sel, 0L),
         dab   = factor(dab, levels = TOP_DABS))

# Per-facet ordering trick: prefix dab so factor levels stay unique-by-facet,
# then use the cAb name as the visible y-axis label via a labeller.
imp_top <- imp_top |>
  mutate(label = paste(dab, cab, sep = "__"),
         label = fct_reorder(label, mean_imp))

label_lookup <- setNames(imp_top$cab, imp_top$label)

p12 <- ggplot(imp_top, aes(mean_imp, label, fill = factor(n_sel))) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = pmax(0, mean_imp - sd_imp),
                    xmax = mean_imp + sd_imp),
                width = 0.3, color = "grey30") +
  geom_text(aes(x = mean_imp + sd_imp,
                label = sprintf("%.2f", mean_imp)),
            hjust = -0.15, size = 2.6, color = "grey20") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_lookup) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18))) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Blues", name = "Selected in\n# seeds (0-3)",
                    drop = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ dab, ncol = 4, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "Mean |LASSO coefficient| across seeds",
       y = NULL,
       title = "Top 8 cAb partners by LASSO importance per top dAb",
       subtitle = "Bar fill = selection frequency in best_features across 3 seeds; error bars = SD; numeric label = mean |coef|") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

save_fig(p12, "12_lasso_pair_importance", width = 14, height = 8)
p12
```
